llm_response.report:
FINDINGS:
The cardiac silhouette is enlarged. There is accentuation of the pulmonary vasculature and above baseline vascular engorgement throughout both lungs, consistent with pulmonary edema. Small bilateral pleural effusions are present, resulting in blunting of the costophrenic angles. Median sternotomy wires are noted overlying the cardiac silhouette. No focal consolidation or pneumothorax is identified.

IMPRESSION:
Findings are consistent with acute congestive heart failure, including cardiomegaly, pulmonary edema, and small bilateral pleural effusions. Status post median sternotomy.
